_help: A chat type (README, "Protected chats in Open WebUI"). Copy this file to ~/.config/localllm/chat-types/<name>.json, edit it, then run install/chat-types.sh.
name: Protected research (example)
description: Questions about your own documents, with lookups only on the sites chosen for it.
system_prompt: You help with questions about the documents in this chat. Answer from the documents and the attached Knowledge base first, and quote the exact wording you rely on. Only when they don't answer the question, use the protected_lookup tool with a short query in general terms (the topic, the rule and its number), never with names, numbers or other details from the documents.
_allowed_sites: Domains a lookup may search and read; each one includes its subdomains (example.org also allows www.example.org).
_sources: Official pages downloaded into this chat type's Knowledge base by install/chat-types.sh --refresh-sources. A source with several urls is joined into one document, in that order; a url with {n:03} is a numbered series (page_001.html, page_002.html, ... until the first missing one).
_patterns: Personal data formats never sent in a lookup, besides the built-in ones (emails, phone numbers, addresses, long numbers, names and numbers from the chat's documents).
_reference_words: A number right after one of these words is a public reference and may be sent ("rule 12", "section 4").
_allowed_patterns: Public reference codes whose numbers may be sent.
_allowed_terms: Capitalised words that are never treated as names, even when they appear in the documents.
starter_prompts: Summarise the attached document and list its deadlines.
Which rule applies to the situation in my document? Quote it.
_users: Open WebUI accounts (their email) that see this chat type; admins always see it.
